nodes.plotka.text.t: "Gossip's not my herb. I heal the body, not the tongue. But I'll tell you this much: more and more folk come to me with the same tiredness in their eyes as after a spark storm. Don't ask me what it means, because I don't know."

nodes.powitanie.options.[plotka].text.t: Know anything about what's going on hereabouts?

nodes.powitanie.options.[q4_zn].text.t: The reeve asked me to find out who's squealing to the Imperials.

nodes.powitanie.options.[q8_start].text.t: What are you short of for your brews?

nodes.powitanie.options.[ranny_po].text.t: I've brought you the wounded miner.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: The hut smells of hay, smoke and cat piss. Dobrawa the wise woman doesn't look up from her mortar. "Something hurt? No? Then what did you come in for? Whoever comes in here without a pain has a made-up one, and those cost the most to cure."

nodes.q4_zn.text.t: Dobrawa is pounding something in her mortar that smells too good to be healthy. "I've seen a fellow with a wineskin he doesn't drink from and a rosary he never runs through his fingers. Walks about at night. To the smith's. I heal, I don't inform, but if you go to the smith, tell him I sent you."

nodes.q8_koniec.text.t: Dobrawa sniffs the bundle, rubs a stalk between her fingers and nods, which is rare for her. "The real thing. Darker than I'd like, but it'll do. Here's two brews and my respect. It's not worth a groat, but it beats nothing."

nodes.q8_start.text.t: Dobrawa sighs as if she were sending you to hell. "Grey reed, from the marshes. It only grows in the mud, where the water stands too still to be healthy. Without it I can't make the fever brew, and fever's mowing folk down like a reaper. Gather me a bundle. Only mind yourself: every kind of devilry sits in that mud, and the birds screaming over it will give a man away from miles off."

nodes.ranny_po.text.t: Dobrawa doesn't take her eyes off the brew. "He's asleep. Leg bruised to the bone, it's a wonder it's not broken. When he wakes, the first thing he'll say is that somebody robbed him. A healthy sign. Good thing you brought him, 'cause that would've cost me three hours on foot."

nodes.ziola.text.t: "I've got everything for sale, but not for everyone. Bandages, brews, ointment for corns and for stupidity. That last one doesn't work, but it sells like hot cakes."
